name: Marvel
description_en:
Marvel is a screen design, prototyping and developer-handoff platform. Teams bring in screens from Marvel, Sketch or uploaded images, add hotspots and interactions, and share a prototype URL for review. Handoff generates design specs, assets and CSS/Swift/Android XML snippets; it does not establish a complete production application.

It is useful for discussing a proposed interface and its navigation before implementation. Evaluate project permissions, contributor versus paid member access, export and current plan availability together. The public pricing page confirms an ongoing free plan and billing rules, but its numeric plan matrix was absent in both HTML and the normal browser read.
description_zh:
Marvel 是页面设计、原型及开发交接平台。团队可导入 Marvel、Sketch 或上传图片中的页面，添加热点和交互，并分享原型 URL 审阅。Handoff 生成设计规格、素材及 CSS/Swift/Android XML 片段，不证明已有完整生产应用。

它适合在实现前讨论界面及导航。应一起评估项目权限、受邀贡献者与付费成员的访问范围、导出和当前方案可用性。公开价格页确认持续免费方案及计费规则，但本次 HTML 与正常浏览器均未显示数值套餐矩阵。

sections.title_en: Review the interface before building the real application
sections.title_zh: 构建真实应用前审阅界面
sections.en:
The [prototyping page](https://marvelapp.com/features/prototyping) describes importing screens from Sketch, Marvel’s design tool or images, then adding hotspots, interactions and layers. It advertises transitions/gestures, URL/embed sharing, user-testing recordings and offline prototype downloads. Those capability statements do not establish inclusion in every plan or current device/plugin compatibility. Ballpark is linked as a separate user-research product; do not merge its entire feature set into Marvel.

Editorial example: prototype a registration flow so reviewers can follow a welcome screen, form screen and confirmation. The form can be represented visually without implementing real authentication or data storage. Marvel is a stronger fit for demonstrating and reviewing the interaction than for proving the backend or deploying an operational service.
sections.zh:
[原型页](https://marvelapp.com/features/prototyping)说明可导入 Sketch、Marvel 设计工具或图片页面，再添加热点、交互和图层。它宣传转场/手势、URL/嵌入分享、用户测试录制及离线原型下载。这些能力表述不证明每档方案均包含，也不证明当前设备/插件兼容。网站把 Ballpark 链接为独立用户研究产品，不能把其全部能力合并进 Marvel。

编辑示例：用注册原型让审阅者从欢迎页走到表单及确认页，视觉上可以模拟表单而不实现真实认证和存储。Marvel 更适合演示和审阅交互，不能据此证明后端或已部署运营服务。

sections.title_en: Prepare screens, connect interactions and inspect the shared view
sections.title_zh: 准备页面、连接交互并检查分享视图
sections.en:
A documentation-based flow is to prepare screens, import them, place hotspots over intended actions, connect destinations and set transitions. Walk through every route in the prototype and then share the review URL or embed. Test dead ends, back navigation and different screen sizes; a visual hotspot over a submit button is not validation of a real submission. The public page describes the workflow at capability level, not every editor dialog.

For feedback, separate navigation observations from engineering acceptance. The page advertises recording screen/audio/video for user testing, but consent, participant handling, plan quotas and recording compatibility need confirmation. The help-center prototype article returned HTTP403 and that origin was stopped without bypass; its detailed instructions were not used. No upload, study or prototype execution was performed.
sections.zh:
基于文档的流程是准备和导入页面，在预期操作上放置热点、连接目标并设置转场，然后逐条走完原型，再分享审阅 URL 或嵌入。应检查死路、返回导航及不同屏幕；提交按钮上的热点不是实际提交验证。公开页面只给能力层级流程，本文不补造每个编辑器对话框。

反馈时应区分导航观察与工程验收。页面宣传用户测试可录屏/录音/录像，但参与者同意、处理方式、套餐额度及兼容性仍需确认。帮助中心原型文章返回 HTTP403，已停止该来源且未绕过，其详细步骤未用于本文。本研究未上传、开展研究或执行原型。

sections.title_en: Specs and code snippets remain an engineering input
sections.title_zh: 规格与代码片段仍是工程输入
sections.en:
The [handoff page](https://marvelapp.com/features/handoff) says a shared URL supplies specs/assets and generates CSS, Swift and Android XML from Marvel or Sketch designs. It also says collaborator changes synchronize with the handoff. This is design inspection and implementation assistance, not evidence of generated business logic, network services, persistence or a compiled app.

Before handoff, agree which prototype version is approved, inspect downloadable assets and font rights, and check that changes have not silently altered the agreed screen. Engineers still map spacing, colors and assets into the real component architecture and test accessibility, responsive behavior and error states. The current Sketch plugin version, export fidelity and offline package contents were not verified.
sections.zh:
[交接页](https://marvelapp.com/features/handoff)表示共享 URL 提供规格/素材，并从 Marvel 或 Sketch 设计生成 CSS、Swift 及 Android XML，协作者改动会同步到交接内容。这是设计检查和实现辅助，不证明生成了业务逻辑、网络服务、持久化或已编译应用。

交接前应约定获批原型版本，检查下载素材及字体权利，确认后续改动未悄悄改变约定页面。工程师仍需把尺寸、颜色和素材映射到真实组件架构，测试可访问性、响应式和错误状态。当前 Sketch 插件版本、导出保真度及离线包内容未核实。

sections.title_en: Price visibility and access scope matter together
sections.title_zh: 价格可见性与访问范围要一起看
sections.en:
The [pricing FAQ](https://marvelapp.com/pricing) says the free plan has no time limit. It charges per Team Member, who can see every project in the account; Contributors are included but see only invited projects. Extra members are prorated on the selected monthly/yearly schedule. For more than six members it directs buyers to Enterprise. Exact free project limits and current paid amounts were not visible in the read page, including a normal browser check, so legacy directory prices are not carried forward.

The FAQ says downgrades are immediate and unused monthly/yearly time is not refunded. Terms specify auto-renewal, cancellation before billing and an Enterprise notice requirement of 30 days before the end date; a written agreement can take priority. The terms also describe a seven-day Team trial with subsequent charging, which must not be confused with the indefinite free plan. Education/nonprofit discounts require eligibility verification rather than automatically applying to all users.
sections.zh:
[价格 FAQ](https://marvelapp.com/pricing)表示免费方案无时限。Team Member 按人计费且可见账户全部项目，内含 Contributors 仅可见受邀项目；增加成员按所选月/年账期比例计费。超过六位成员引导至 Enterprise。实读页面及正常浏览器未显示具体免费项目上限或当前付费金额，因此不沿用旧目录价格。

FAQ 表示降级立即生效，月/年剩余时间不退款。条款列出自动续费、账单日前取消，以及 Enterprise 在结束日前 30 天通知的要求，书面协议可优先。条款另描述七天 Team 试用后收费，不能与无限期免费方案混淆。教育/非营利折扣需核实资格，不自动适用于所有用户。

sections.title_en: Hosted service rights and project responsibility
sections.title_zh: 托管服务权利与项目责任
sections.en:
The [terms](https://marvelapp.com/terms) distinguish users’ uploaded content from Marvel’s software and other platform IP. Users are responsible for permissions to upload/share content and personal data; platform access does not license third-party fonts, images or a client’s confidential screens. Marvel can retain attribution under its terms. This is proprietary hosted software, not an open-source grant from the code snippets or API link.

Operationally, verify the intended project invitation rather than adding a person as an all-project paid member by default. Confirm export/backup and retention before ending service. No account permissions, private project, purchase, downgrade, test recording, plugin or handoff build was exercised; vendor claims of synchronized or correct specs are not independent acceptance evidence.
sections.zh:
[条款](https://marvelapp.com/terms)区分用户上传内容与 Marvel 的软件及其他平台知识产权。用户需负责上传/分享内容和个人数据的权限，平台访问不自动授予第三方字体、图像或客户机密页面的使用权。Marvel 可按条款保留署名。代码片段或 API 链接不构成开源授权，软件属于专有托管服务。

运营上应核对具体项目邀请，不能默认把协作者加成可见全部项目的付费成员。结束服务前应确认导出/备份及保留。本研究未执行账户权限、私密项目、购买、降级、研究录制、插件或交接构建；厂商关于同步或规格正确的表述不是独立验收证据。
